[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Kiral''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed aboard the [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']] he served as a supply officer, exchanging obsolete materials for new resources.

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Kiral was a merchant NPC in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was introduced following Patch 2.0 as an exchange agent for Republic players, trading gear drops removed from the game for commendations.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
